title: Bram and the Recipe
author: Ulyana Sterling
blurb: Quentin Marchetti, the team's statistician who knows the game is rigged, counts days until graduation like a sentence being served. But when a group chat starts predicting things that haven't happened yet, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must expose what the school board buried, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
